lines.line: Bot Battle runs in the browser, here on a phone held upright.
Before the fight, all three bots show off, and then you play with the buttons on screen.
On a computer, you pick your mode and fighter with the mouse or the keyboard.
During the match, the keys for every move are listed along the bottom.
Turn the phone on its side and the buttons fold into two rows.
Here, ChatGPT's cursor takes control of Stack Overflow.
